name: Shady Oaks RV Resort
lede: Pull-through and back-in spots for every kind of RV traveler, a short drive from the charming town of Wimberley. Pet friendly, with a laundromat on the grounds.
hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 9 am to 5 pm
